## Versioning policy

| Change type | Version increment | Example |
|---|---|---|
| New marker group or major restructuring | Major | `v1.0.0` → `v2.0.0` |
| Added genomes, proteins or improved coverage | Minor | `v1.0.0` → `v1.1.0` |
| Documentation or small metadata corrections | Patch | `v1.0.0` → `v1.0.1` |

## Release checklist

Before each public release:

- regenerate `output/VirMarkDB/`;
- run `Rscript docs/scripts/build_docs_analysis.R`;
- update `docs/data/` tables;
- update this release page (version, date, DOI, checksum);
- update `CHANGELOG.md`;
- update `CITATION.cff`;
- build archive and compute checksum;
- deposit archive on Zenodo;
- update DOI and download link above.
